sector_model: Active asset manager with money market concentration: AUM, flows by asset class, fee waivers, margin, acquisitions, capital return; not valued on generic cash flow alone.
thesis: Federated Hermes (NYSE: FHI). Q3 2026 10-Q (0001056288-26-000030, filed 2026-10-30): revenue 507.3M vs 469.4M (+8.1%), 9M 1,489.1M vs 1,317.8M (+13.0%, includes 80% FCP acquisition closed 2026-04-09); operating income 153.3M vs 129.5M (9M 412.5M vs 378.3M); net income attributable 111.9M vs 104.1M (9M 312.6M vs 296.3M); diluted EPS 1.50 vs 1.34 (9M 4.15 vs 3.75). Money market revenue 251.9M in Q3, 49% of revenue (52% year ago); fee waivers 109.3M in Q3. 9M OCF 243.9M vs 136.1M; capex 20.0M vs 3.2M; dividends 83.1M; buybacks 186.1M. Cash 373.7M (582.5M at year end after the FCP deal), senior notes 348.6M, total liabilities 1,004.2M. TTM (matched periods): revenue 1,971.9M, NI 419.6M, OCF 405.1M, capex 19.6M, FCF 385.6M. Close 63.76 on 2026-11-13 (two aggregators agree; origin not documented), shares 73.93M (cover 2026-10-23): market cap 4.71B, 11.2x TTM, FCF yield 8.2%, dividend 1.52 (2.4%). Aggregator: forward P/E 10.6, EV/EBITDA 7.7. Market view: money market assets are rate cyclical and could shrink as cash yields fall; price assumes that. Evidence that differs: money market revenue still rising (+3% Q3) and diversification via acquisitions. Edward Jones about 10% of revenue. Not a bargain proof: cheap on earnings, cyclical earnings base, OCF in 9M25 was depressed so TTM FCF yield flatters versus NI.
counterthesis: Falling short term rates reduce money fund yields and may push assets or fee waivers either way; 51% of revenue is money market. Fee waivers of 329.6M in 9M are a margin cap that can reverse or grow. FCP integration costs and preliminary purchase accounting (goodwill 1,114.3M); contingent consideration 41.5M. Securities gains fell (8.6M vs 19.8M). Working capital: FY25 OCF 297M was far below NI 403M, so cash conversion has been volatile. Insider Form 4 and Form 144 on 2026-11-09 unread. Peers (TROW, BEN, IVZ, AMG), AUM and flows, own history, MD&A and legal Note 18 not read.
invalidation: Thesis fails if money market assets decline materially with rate cuts, fee waivers rise, the operating margin falls below about 25%, or OCF stays well below net income.
